context: A gentle afternoon at the community center. Three women in different stages of widowhood/aging share tea.
purpose: three-generation elder women — quiet shared wisdom of widowhood

lines.speaker: mrs_mori_neighbor
lines.jp: さちこさん、最近、いかが？
lines.style: Neighbor warm gentle bright sincere-warm friendship-asking, the soft real real-warmth audible, gentle real warmth throughout delivery.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: なんとか。一人の時間にも、ちょっとずつ慣れて。
lines.en: Somehow. Bit by bit, getting used to alone time.
lines.style: Soft grandmother warm soft tender honest-sincere-warm sharing, the soft real real-warmth audible, gentle real warmth throughout delivery.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: 私も、毎週来るようにしてます。
lines.en: I've been coming every week too.
lines.style: Aunt warm soft sincere warm-supporting-disclosure, the soft real real-warmth audible, gentle real warmth throughout delivery.

lines.speaker: mrs_mori_neighbor
lines.jp: 私もね、主人亡くしてから、十年。ずいぶん経つけど、まだ夢に出てくる。
lines.en: After losing my husband — ten years. Long time, but he still appears in dreams.
lines.style: Neighbor warm soft tender deep sincere-sharing-warm wisdom, the soft real real-warmth audible, gentle real warmth throughout delivery.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: そうですか…私も、毎日のように、夢を見ます。
lines.en: Is that so… I too, almost every day, dream.
lines.style: Soft grandmother warm soft tender deep gentle-matching-warm, the soft real real-warmth audible, gentle real warmth throughout delivery.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: お父さん、今でも、お母さんに会いに来てるのね。
lines.en: Father — even now, coming to see mother.
lines.style: Aunt warm soft tender sincere-comforting-warm interpreting, the soft real real-warmth audible, gentle real warmth throughout delivery.

lines.speaker: mrs_mori_neighbor
lines.jp: こうやって、お話できる友達がいるって、本当に大事。
lines.en: Having friends to talk with like this — truly important.
lines.style: Neighbor warm gentle sincere deep philosophical-warm reflection, the soft real real-warmth audible, gentle real warmth throughout delivery.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 本当に。一人で抱えてたら、辛かった。
lines.en: Truly. Carrying alone — would have been hard.
lines.style: Soft grandmother warm soft tender sincere-deep-warm sharing, the soft real real-warmth audible, gentle real warmth throughout delivery.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: お母さんが森さんと、こういう友達でいてくれて、私も感謝してます。
lines.en: Mother with Mori-san — being friends like this, I'm grateful too.
lines.style: Aunt warm soft sincere deep-warm extending-grateful, the soft real real-warmth audible, gentle real warmth throughout delivery.

lines.speaker: mrs_mori_neighbor
lines.jp: こちらこそ。さちこさん、いいお人柄で。
lines.en: Same. Sachiko-san is a good person.
lines.style: Neighbor warm gentle sincere-warm appreciating-closing, the soft real real-warmth audible, gentle real warmth throughout delivery.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: こうやって笑えるの、嬉しい。少しずつね。
lines.en: Being able to laugh like this — happy. Bit by bit.
lines.style: Soft grandmother warm soft tender sincere-bright-warm closing, the soft real real-warmth audible, gentle real warmth throughout delivery.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: また来週、お茶しましょう。
lines.en: Let's have tea again next week.
lines.style: Aunt warm soft sincere closing-warm extending, the soft real real-warmth audible, gentle real warmth throughout delivery.
